content.preheader: A longer one this week. Worth the coffee, I hope.
content.title: What we got wrong this year
content.paragraph_1: A year ago I wrote that we'd never add a free plan. We added one in March. This is the story of why, and the three other things I was wrong about.
content.paragraph_2: The first mistake was thinking people wanted more features. They wanted fewer decisions. Every setting we removed this year raised activation.
content.pull_quote: Every setting we removed this year raised activation.
content.paragraph_3: The second was believing that speed didn't matter to small teams. It matters most to them: they don't have time to wait for anything.
content.closing: The full letter, with the numbers, is on the blog.
